name: Climb Worm Tower for Brainrots
desc:
Climb Worm Tower for Brainrots

How To Play:
🧗 Climb the stairs as far as you can without being eaten by the WORM
😂 Collect Brainrots from higher floors
🍀 Invite your friends to beat the worm easily!
💸 Your Brainrots generate you money!
⚡ Make sure to use the safe zones to stay safe from the worms

💤 Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE!
